risk_families.label: Preflight bypass
risks: The agent skips the external-image capability question or infers a local route.
Retrieval or writing starts before board, level, market, subject, year, language, mode, batch scope, and output directory are valid.
constraints: The first handbook response is the structured preflight only.
Incomplete or unverified fields block every downstream phase.
self_repair: Re-open preflight state and ask only for missing or invalid fields.
Invalidate any downstream artifact created before preflight completion.

risk_families.label: Syllabus granularity
risks: Broad Topic or Unit headings are mistaken for final teaching points.
Python or templates replace LLM source interpretation.
constraints: The LLM maps independently assessable source requirements before writing.
Every merge needs a source-based teaching reason and visible treatment.
self_repair: Rebuild the outline from source coverage and container audits.
Reject topics without an independent source item.

risk_families.label: State and hash drift
risks: A manifest rebuild removes imported assets or resets approvals.
Old outlines, HTML, review ledgers, PDFs, or delivery copies are mixed with current state.
constraints: Preserve rebuild, import, approve, render-only order.
Every mutable input change invalidates downstream approval and delivery state.
self_repair: Rebuild the affected state chain from the earliest changed input.
Compare current artifact hashes before approval or export.

risk_families.label: Visual teaching semantics
risks: Decorative text rectangles are counted as explanatory SVGs.
Visuals look polished but contain wrong labels, arrows, structures, units, or relationships.
constraints: Decide the medium independently for every final teaching point.
The LLM reviews the rendered subject meaning of every visual.
self_repair: Reject visuals without independent structure, relationship, quantity, or spatial meaning.
Regenerate or replace any semantically incorrect visual and review again.

risk_families.label: HTML review and PDF delivery
risks: Machine diagnostics are treated as approval.
PDF is exported before complete visible HTML review or from stale approval.
constraints: The LLM personally reviews and repairs the complete current HTML.
PDF export requires current HTML, render, ledger, visual, PDF, and delivery hashes.
self_repair: Return to HTML repair and rerender until the exact current version passes.
Block export on any pending, rejected, stale, missing, or mismatched state.

risk_families.label: Batch isolation
risks: Several subjects share one outline, visual review, HTML approval, or sampled conclusion.
constraints: Each handbook completes the full workflow independently.
self_repair: Invalidate shared conclusions and review every subject from its own current artifacts.

human_judgment_boundary: Confirm the complete preflight and verify the selected image route before starting any downstream work.
Resolve official provider, market, qualification, stage, course, and year ambiguity instead of guessing or substituting.
Let the LLM decide syllabus meaning, atomic teaching points, teaching content, visual route, semantic correctness, and approval.
Require complete review of the exact current HTML and matching evidence hashes before authorizing PDF export.
Review every batch subject independently and never approve from a sample or another subject's state.
